findings.description: MG introduces Even through before a concessive clause.

contexts.japanese: 例え、傷口ばっくり見せられちゃっても、赤くなきゃそう来るわよねぇ基本よねぇ？！
contexts.japanesePS3: 例え、傷口ばっくり見せられちゃっても、赤くなきゃそう来るわよねぇ基本よねぇ？！
contexts.MG: Even through you've been shown their gaping wounds, you're still trying that one on principle, as long as there's no red, right?!
contexts.UP: Even if I showed you their gaping wounds, you've still gotta try that one if it wasn't in red, right?! That's like the basics of the basics!

findings.sourceReading: MG Even through you have been shown cannot introduce this concessive clause. Original PC29358–29359 has Even if; UP also uses Even if.
findings.alternative: A readily understood typo; still independently introduced into MG rather than inherited from original WH.

findings.description: Original PC explicitly 知的強姦者/intellectual rapist; maintained PS3 JP uses 知的蹂躙者. Both English witnesses retain the PC sexual metaphor. Subsequent occurrence of the CH06 designation.

contexts.japanese: ……自らを知的蹂躙者とまで言ってのけた少女が、……廊下に姿を現す。
contexts.japanesePC: 真実そのものよりも、それを暴く過程に悦楽を感じると豪語し、......自らを知的強姦者とまで言ってのけた少女が、......廊下に姿を現す。
contexts.japanesePS3: ……自らを知的蹂躙者とまで言ってのけた少女が、……廊下に姿を現す。
contexts.WH: The girl who bragged that she drew more pleasure from the process of exposing the truth rather than the truth itself......and who went so far as to call herself an intellectual rapist, ......appeared in the hall.
contexts.MG: ...and who went so far as to call herself an intellectual rapist, ...appeared in the hall.
